goal: Wave 3 build: Agent scope for named agents (dark); Transcript density levels; Role parameter on subagent.task from published definitions; MCP elicitation transport in the gateway (held call, answer service, schema mapping); Question origin contract: run_questions origin columns, proto fields, store; ADR stub: dedicated user-content origin deferred; API-key exchange route in auth-core; Agent API v1 contract, SDK target and refusal keys NOTE: run every pnpm command with the env var pnpm_config_verify_deps_before_run=false. Typecheck the frontend with node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc6 -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit (tsconfig.json checks nothing). NOTE: every new switch defaults off; never flip one. A change to any .proto needs generated code: put the exact buf/regen step in lead_todo instead of hand-editing generated Go files, keep the change additive, and comment every new field and message (buf lint ratchet). NOTE: one model-gateway plus execution-core test build takes most of the free disk, so build only the test targets your slice names; never create a new cargo target directory, use only the given targetDir. NOTE: a change to a platform prompt or a tool definition must regenerate apps/Model Plane/rust/crates/mp-contracts/tests/fixtures/prompt-tool-manifest.json (MP_UPDATE_PROMPT_MANIFEST=1 cargo test -p mp-contracts --test prompt_tool_manifest) and add or update an eval case or replay cassette (scenario-touch gate). NOTE: Wave 3 is built in wave mode: build the code and its tests, log depth findings, no live stack and no docker (the lead runs docker). Live proofs go to the depth phase. NOTE: code first (owner order 2026-11-03): write the code and the unit tests the row names, do not run them; one guard agent compiles after the batch. session-core migrations taken: 0100, 0101, 0103, 0104, 0105 (EP-4-S5), 0106 (EP-12-S14) and any newer file in the migrations folder: take your reserved round-B number if still free, else the next free number; capability-core the next free at or above 0036. Never add zdr-posture-matrix rows for a feature refusal (rows are keyed on bearers and route only); use zdr_features.rs, the feature table and docs/ZDR.md. pytest and python-pptx are not installed. action-registry.test.ts P-SPA1 is main's pre-existing failure. Error bodies keep {error:{code,message,details}} with details an object.

slices.title: API-key exchange route in auth-core
slices.summary: New auth-core controller POST /api/:audience/api-key-exchange (switch API_KEY_AGENT_EXCHANGE_ENABLED, on top of API_KEY_ENABLED) plus a pure policy module: verifies the registered caller's apiKeyExchange registry list, verifies a user-keys API key with Better Auth, checks org binding, membership and key permission against a closed audience-scope table, raises zdr from org posture or key flag, and mints an api_key principal token (sub apikey:<key_id>, key_id, acting_user_id, no user_id, TTL <= 120 s, jti) through issuePlaneToken, which learns principalType api_key.
